t: 一支由52艘船组成的西班牙和葡萄牙联合舰队在荷兰-葡萄牙战争期间开始从荷兰人手中夺回巴伊亚.
te: A combined Spanish and Portuguese fleet of 52 ships commences the recapture of Bahia from the Dutch during the Dutch–Po…
dz: 一支由52艘船组成的西班牙和葡萄牙联合舰队在荷兰-葡萄牙战争期间开始从荷兰人手中夺回巴伊亚.
de: A combined Spanish and Portuguese fleet of 52 ships commences the recapture of Bahia from the Dutch during the Dutch–Portuguese War.

t: 建立了圣托马斯宗座和皇家大学,菲律宾天主教大学和世界上最大的天主教大学.
te: Establishment of the Pontifical and Royal University of Santo Tomas, the Catholic University of the Philippines and the…
dz: 建立了圣托马斯宗座和皇家大学,菲律宾天主教大学和世界上最大的天主教大学.
de: Establishment of the Pontifical and Royal University of Santo Tomas, the Catholic University of the Philippines and the largest Catholic university in the world.

t: 塞里尼奥拉战役被打. 它被指为历史上首次由小武器用火药射击而取胜的欧洲战役之一.
te: The Battle of Cerignola is fought. It is noted as one of the first European battles in history won by small arms fire u…
dz: 塞里尼奥拉战役被打. 它被指为历史上首次由小武器用火药射击而取胜的欧洲战役之一.
de: The Battle of Cerignola is fought. It is noted as one of the first European battles in history won by small arms fire using gunpowder.

t: 忽必烈之孙铁木尔被选为蒙古可汗，年号为奥尔杰图。
te: Temür, grandson of Kublai, is elected Khagan of the Mongols with the reigning title Oljeitu.
dz: 忽必烈之孙铁木尔被选为蒙古可汗，年号为奥尔杰图。
de: Temür, grandson of Kublai, is elected Khagan of the Mongols with the reigning title Oljeitu.

t: 尼一仁是日本佛教僧人,他首次提出"纳木·妙花·伦格·觉"并宣布这是佛教的精髓,实际上创立了尼一…
te: Nichiren, a Japanese Buddhist monk, propounds Namu Myōhō Renge Kyō for the first time and declares it to be the essence…
dz: 尼一仁是日本佛教僧人,他首次提出"纳木·妙花·伦格·觉"并宣布这是佛教的精髓,实际上创立了尼一仁佛教.
de: Nichiren, a Japanese Buddhist monk, propounds Namu Myōhō Renge Kyō for the first time and declares it to be the essence of Buddhism, in effect founding Nichiren Buddhism.

t: 刺杀耶路撒冷国王蒙费拉特(英语:Conrad I)的康拉德(英语:Conferrat (Con…
te: Assassination of Conrad of Montferrat (Conrad I), King of Jerusalem, in Tyre, two days after his title to the throne is…
dz: 刺杀耶路撒冷国王蒙费拉特(英语:Conrad I)的康拉德(英语:Conferrat (Conrad I))于提尔,即其王位头衔被选举确认后两天. 杀戮由哈什沙申进行.
de: Assassination of Conrad of Montferrat (Conrad I), King of Jerusalem, in Tyre, two days after his title to the throne is confirmed by election. The killing is carried out by Hashshashin.

t: 君士坦提乌斯二世皇帝首次进入罗马庆祝他对马格努斯·马格嫩提乌斯的胜利。
te: Emperor Constantius II enters Rome for the first time to celebrate his victory over Magnus Magnentius.
dz: 君士坦提乌斯二世皇帝首次进入罗马庆祝他对马格努斯·马格嫩提乌斯的胜利。
de: Emperor Constantius II enters Rome for the first time to celebrate his victory over Magnus Magnentius.

t: 霍尔莫兹德干战役被打. 阿达希尔一世击败并杀死了阿尔塔巴努斯五世,有效地终结了Parthian…
te: The Battle of Hormozdgan is fought. Ardashir I defeats and kills Artabanus V, effectively ending the Parthian Empire.
dz: 霍尔莫兹德干战役被打. 阿达希尔一世击败并杀死了阿尔塔巴努斯五世,有效地终结了Parthian帝国.
de: The Battle of Hormozdgan is fought. Ardashir I defeats and kills Artabanus V, effectively ending the Parthian Empire.
